versions.changelog: Make clawd narrator skill wrappers always delegate to the canonical /Users/buddy/narrator pipeline (real implementation); remove prototype-side execution paths.
Align skill docs with /Users/buddy/narrator upstream implementation; replace local prototype claims with real repo-backed usage and control-flow commands.
Sync with repo: add 7 styles (sports, nature, horror, noir, reality_tv, asmr, wrestling), ElevenLabs TTS integration, ambient tracks, live control protocol, simplify metadata

Initial release of Screen Narrator.

- Provides live narration of your screen activity in 7 distinct styles (sports, nature, horror, noir, reality_tv, asmr, wrestling).
- Allows live switching between narration styles and profanity levels using simple JSON commands.
- Supports start, stop, pause, resume, style change, and profanity control via tmux and control files.
- Each style features unique voices and ambient tracks.
- Includes timer support for automatic session length.
- Status can be checked at any time via status file.
